verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs repeatedly say its agents fix bugs and handle development tasks across repositories. They also describe the pieces of an end-to-end loop: picking up issues from Linear/Jira (with Sentry listed as an integration), triggering agents when CI builds fail, testing changes in isolated sandboxes, and opening pull requests with the fix. missing for 10: a detailed first-party walkthrough of the diagnose-to-fix bug workflow, any independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent fixes reported bugs autonomously, and evidence of how diagnosis (root-cause analysis) is performed beyond the marketing claims.
